name: sweeper
description: Test tooling only: jsdom renders the web UI in the test suite. sweeper itself needs nothing but Python and requests.

scripts.test: python3 test_linkmap.py && python3 test_tidy.py && python3 test_i18n.py && npm run -s test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: python3 test_e2e.py && E2E_REMOTE=1 python3 test_e2e.py && E2E_REMOTE=1 E2E_NO_MAP=1 python3 test_e2e.py
